arguments.command:
cat > /tmp/isoex.py <<'EOF'
import sys,struct
f=open('/app/alpine.iso','rb')
def rd(lba,n=1):
    f.seek(lba*2048); return f.read(2048*n)
pvd=rd(16)
root=pvd[156:156+34]
def parse_dir(rec):
    lba=struct.unpack('<I',rec[2:6])[0]; size=struct.unpack('<I',rec[10:14])[0]
    data=rd(lba,(size+2047)//2048)[:size]
    out=[];i=0
    while i<len(data):
        l=data[i]
        if l==0:
            i=(i//2048+1)*2048; continue
        r=data[i:i+l]
        nl=r[32]; name=r[33:33+nl].decode('latin1')
        flags=r[25]
        out.append((name,flags,struct.unpack('<I',r[2:6])[0],struct.unpack('<I',r[10:14])[0]))
        i+=l
    return out
def walk(rec,path=''):
    for name,flags,lba,size in parse_dir(rec):
        if name in ('\x00','\x01'): continue
        p=path+'/'+name
        if flags&2:
            fake=b'\x00\x00'+struct.pack('<I',lba)+b'\x00'*4+struct.pack('<I',size)+b'\x00'*20
            yield from walk(fake,p)
        else:
            yield p,lba,size
for p,lba,size in walk(root):
    print(p,size)
EOF

def rd(lba,n=1):
    f.seek(lba*2048); return f.read(2048*n)

        if l==0: i=(i//2048+1)*2048; continue

import socket, threading, time

VM = ('127.0.0.1', 6666)
LISTEN = ('127.0.0.1', 6665)

def pump(a, b):
    try:
        while True:
            d = a.recv(4096)
            if not d:
                break
            b.sendall(d)
    except OSError:
        pass
    finally:
        for s in (a, b):
            try:
                s.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
            except OSError:
                pass

def handle(cli):
    try:
        vm = socket.create_connection(VM, 10)
    except OSError:
        cli.close()
        return
    # nudge the serial console so a fresh login prompt is drawn for this client
    def nudge():
        time.sleep(0.4)
        try:
            vm.sendall(b'\r\n')
        except OSError:
            pass
    threading.Thread(target=nudge, daemon=True).start()
    threading.Thread(target=pump, args=(cli, vm), daemon=True).start()
    pump(vm, cli)
    cli.close()
    vm.close()

srv = socket.socket()
srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
srv.bind(LISTEN)
srv.listen(8)
while True:
    c, _ = srv.accept()
    threading.Thread(target=handle, args=(c,), daemon=True).start()
EOF

        vm = socket.create_connection(VM, 10)
    except OSError:
        cli.close()
        return
    # nudge the serial console so a fresh login prompt is drawn for this client
    def nudge():
        time.sleep(0.4)
        try:
            vm.sendall(b'\r\n')
        except OSError:
            pass
    threading.Thread(target=nudge, daemon=True).start()
    threading.Thread(target=pump, args=(cli, vm), daemon=True).start()
    pump(vm, cli)
    cli.close()
    vm.close()

srv = socket.socket()
srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
srv.bind(LISTEN)
srv.listen(8)
while True:
    c, _ = srv.accept()
    threading.Thread(target=handle, args=(c,), daemon=True).start()
